text:
jamie: Quick sync — console observability roadmap status. We're aiming to ship dashboards + tracing hooks + error-analysis views + retention config by EOM. Can each owner confirm blockers, ETA, and any cross-team deps? cc @maria @kevin @sophia :eyes:

maria: I can own dashboards (frontend + per-route cost panels). Biggest blocker: metrics-schema PR (eng-platform repo) needs a couple more fields from runtime (token_count, cache_hits). PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-platform/pull/452 — waiting on runtime owner. ETA: I can finish UI work by 1795557600 if schema lands this week. :thumbsup:

kevin: Tracing hooks mostly in for new runtime paths. Legacy service adapters (auth-proxy, legacy-ingest) still need instrumentation. I'll open a short task list and tag owners. No hard blockers other than scheduling infra time to roll the adapter threads. ETA for core hooks: 1795557000; legacy adapters: 1795559800 (depends on ops window).

jamie: @kevin please drop the adapter owners here so we can nudge them. Also, are the trace sampling defaults aligned with cost targets? We don't want explosion in ingest costs.

kevin: Sampling defaults are 1% for low qps routes, 10% for high qps. I've got a cost-model spreadsheet — will share in a follow-up. For rollout, plan is canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with fallback.

sophia: Regarding retention: product wants 1y for error-analysis views, but infra is pushing back due to storage cost. We proposed retention tiers: 90d free, 1y premium. Need legal/CS input for compliance customers. Action: estimate incremental storage cost and opt-in UX. Sample config for retention API below:

```json
{
  "project_id": "redwood-console",
  "observability": {
    "error_view": { "retention_days": 365, "tier": "premium" },
    "traces": { "retention_days": 90 }
  }
}
```

maria: UX note — if we show premium toggle in console, add clear cost estimate per month per project. I can mock that if ops provides numbers.

kevin: @sophia I'll add storage delta to the spreadsheet and tag SRE for budget approval.

jamie: Ownership check — dashboards = maria (frontend) + kevin (backend metrics endpoints), tracing hooks = kevin, error-analysis retention = sophia (policy + cost) + maria (UI). I'll list these in the roadmap doc and start canary roll plan.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: metrics-schema v2 -> staging at 1795555600, production at 1795559200 (automated). See release notes: https://releases.internal/redwood/metrics-schema/v2

maria: Noted — I'll hold UI merge until staging schema is up.

kevin: Putting checklist in the PR: instrumented services, sampling config, canary plan, rollback steps. Will ping owners tomorrow morning.

jamie: Perfect. Next sync async update Friday 14:00 PT. If anyone needs a quick sync before then, drop times here. :calendar:
